name: IDEAS — Imaging Database for Epilepsy And Surgery
theme: T1 Build: anatomy and connectomes
accession: ds007401 (T1w/FLAIR shared with IDEAS II); figshare for masks, FreeSurfer, clinical tables
access_steps: Download from OpenNeuro / figshare links on cnnp-lab.com/ideas-data; no application.
age: adult surgical centre; min age at surgery 16; ages shared in 5-year bins
epilepsy_types: drug-resistant focal epilepsy; 356 TLE and 58 frontal resections among 433 masks
sites: 1 (UCLH / National Hospital for Neurology & Neurosurgery, London)
data_types: 3D T1w (all), 3D FLAIR (where available); 3T GE; FSPGR 0.94×0.94×1.1 mm or MPRAGE 1 mm
format: BIDS NIfTI + JSON sidecars; FreeSurfer 7.3.2 recon-all outputs; region tables (DK, Lausanne multi-scale, Destrieux, HCP-MMP1, Whittaker)
size: ds007401 is 20.5 GB in total (T1w/FLAIR for 542 subjects + DWI for 314)
labels: Resection masks from post-operative imaging for 433/442
outcomes: Annual ILAE outcome up to 5 years: 427 at 12 mo, 403 at 24 mo, 356 at 36 mo, 311 at 48 mo, 267 at 60 mo
derived: FreeSurfer surfaces/volumes; thickness, area and volume tables for several parcellations
caveats: No electrophysiology at all: no SOZ, no seizures | Resection mask is a 'silver standard' for the EZ, not ground truth | Single centre, adult resective surgery over ~20 years | Clinical table is on figshare, not in the OpenNeuro participants file (ds007401 has no participants.tsv)
pipeline_use: Patient-specific anatomy for the virtual brain plus a surgical ground truth (mask + ILAE). With IDEAS II connectomes it supports a 'virtual resection vs outcome' test on 400+ patients without any iEEG.
what_we_opened: Cloned ds007401 git tree: dataset_description, README, file tree (542 sub- folders, 2066 anat files); read full text PMC11827737.
key_claim: Largest open surgical-epilepsy MRI set: 442 patients with resection masks and up to 5-year ILAE outcomes, but no electrophysiology.

name: IDEAS II — diffusion MRI and structural connectomes
theme: T1 Build: anatomy and connectomes
accession: ds007401 v1.0.0 (raw); processed tensors/connectomes on figshare
access_steps: OpenNeuro download (DataLad/AWS/CLI); processed data via figshare links.
epilepsy_types: drug-resistant focal epilepsy; IDS aligned with IDEAS
data_types: DWI, 2 protocols: P1 (n=167, 2014–19, GE MR750, 2 mm iso); P2 (n=147, 2009–13, GE Signa HDx, b=1200 s/mm², 52 directions + 6 b0). Multishell for 98 patients and 69 controls
format: BIDS NIfTI + .bval/.bvec; FA/MD maps native + MNI152; connectome matrices
size: ds007401 is 20.5 GB in total (raw); 314 DWI sessions
labels: Inherits IDEAS resection masks
outcomes: Inherits IDEAS ILAE outcomes
derived: 80 connectivity matrices per person (det/prob tractography × Lausanne scales 36/60/125/250 × 5 weights × dilated or not); networks for 191 patients and 97 controls
caveats: DWI and T1w sometimes from different sessions (interval <24 months in 69%) | Parcellations are Lausanne/DK, not the 162-region VEP atlas used by VEC; re-parcellate from raw for VEP | 51 patients and 29 controls overlap with ENIGMA
pipeline_use: The only large open source of patient-specific structural connectomes paired with resection masks and outcomes: the natural 'build' input for an Epileptor/TVB network and a virtual-surgery check.
what_we_opened: Cloned ds007401: 314 .bval/.bvec pairs, CC0 licence, README; full text PMC13285235.
key_claim: Open DWI for 216 patients + 98 controls with ready connectomes for 191 patients, linked to IDEAS masks and outcomes.

name: Epilepsy-iEEG-Multicenter-Dataset (fragility cohort)
theme: T2 Real iEEG with labels and outcomes
access_steps: OpenNeuro download. Cleveland Clinic patients are withheld and need a separate DUA.
